title: Systematic Mapping Protocol. Generative AI-Augmented Requirements Engineering: A Systematic Mapping Study of Practices, Specifications, and Reuse in Software Development
abstract: arXiv:2611.23349v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Generative artificial intelligence (GenAI), particularly large language models (LLMs), is rapidly being adopted in requirements engineering (RE). Existing secondary studies have characterized which RE activities are supported and which prompting strategies are used, but little is known about the specifications that GenAI-augmented RE produces and how they are used in subsequent activities such as specification-driven development (SDD), design and code generation, test derivation, verification, and reuse. This document presents the protocol of a systematic mapping study (SMS) that will identify and classify research on GenAI-augmented RE, with particular attention to the work products it generates and their downstream use. translated_title: 系统映射协议：生成式人工智能增强的需求工程——软件开发中实践、规范与复用的系统映射研究
translated_abstract: 生成式人工智能（GenAI），特别是大语言模型（LLM），正在需求工程（RE）领域得到迅速应用。现有的二次研究已经梳理了GenAI支持哪些需求工程活动以及使用了哪些提示策略，但对于GenAI增强的需求工程所产生的规范，以及这些规范如何在后续活动（如规范驱动开发（SDD）、设计与代码生成、测试推导、验证和复用）中被使用，目前知之甚少。本文档提出了一项系统映射研究（SMS）的方案，该研究将识别并分类关于GenAI增强需求工程的研究，尤其关注其生成的工作产品及其下游应用。该方案定义了研究问题及其分类方案、检索策略、研究筛选流程、数据提取表、分析方法、工具支持以及有效性威胁。
tldr: 本文提出了一项系统映射研究的协议方案，旨在识别和分类生成式AI增强的需求工程研究，重点关注其产生的规范等工件在规范驱动开发、代码生成、测试推导、验证与复用等下游活动中的应用。
en_tdlr: This paper presents a systematic mapping study protocol to identify and classify research on GenAI-augmented requirements engineering, with particular focus on how the specifications it produces are used in downstream activities such as specification-driven development, design and code generation, test derivation, verification, and reuse.
